item.text: {"paper_id":"paper002","profile_id":"neuroscience","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"Preliminary evaluation in three pwMS showed consistent improvements in artifact mitigation, structural delineation, and lesion conspicuity with navigator correction, providing proof‐of‐concept for potential clinical application.","rationale":"The study improves spinal cord imaging and multiple sclerosis lesion visualization, directly supporting assessment of neural pathology and diagnosis of a neurological disorder.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
